correctness.rationale: The coset parity agrees across the two bracketings. For outside parity, (l u)^(-1)(r u)=r^(-1)l, since outside elements are involutions; for even parity use l^(-1)r. Recomputing the bracketings with the four given rules produces the displayed table. For example, at 111 the base elements are k h^(-1)g and g h^(-1)k; taking their quotient in the outside-coset order gives k^(-1)h g^(-1)k h^(-1)g, equal to the stated h-conjugate. At 011 the even bracketings are k^(-1)h g and g k^(-1)h, giving [g,k^(-1)h]. Across the seven sectors the pair changes have one free variable and the 111 conjugation preserves fibers. The 000 contribution is concentrated at 1 and the total is 8m^3. For odd dihedral n, the three sectors of group pairs involving at least one reflection each hit any given rotation n times, since doubling the relevant label or label difference is invertible modulo n; rotation pairs contribute n^2 at 1 alone. The boxed values follow with m=2n. Read RESULT.md, VERIFICATION.md and verify_associators.py; the supplied finite enumerator was inspected, not executed, and is not used for the proof.
